author: Dave Proffer
attribution: Photo: Dave Proffer, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Africa0703-0642a_-_Flickr_-_Dave_Proffer.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black hotel sign on posts, Bujumbura; all lower case; 'du' is drawn over a beige Africa silhouette. A row of facility pictograms ('24h', ...) hangs below. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Never_give_up_shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted shop name across the top of a blue-grey shop front, Rumonge; 'USIKATE TAMAA' ('don't lose hope') runs vertically down the right edge, one letter per line. Mixed case as painted ('never Give up SHOP'). The small painted phone number, the 'BOUTIQUE ...' sign at left and the drinks list are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boutique_Ibintu_ni_Imana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted name on a white shop wall, Rumonge; the same name is repeated smaller on the side wall. Distractors: 'LUMICASH EcoCash' mobile-money adverts, the 'LAVAGE VEHICULES / CAR WASH / TUNAOSHA GARI' board and the 'CPVV FBP' ministry board in front. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Arthur Nkunzimana
attribution: Photo: Arthur Nkunzimana, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Butike_kaze_muronke_yo_mu_Nkayamba.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small roadside shop in Nkayamba (Rumonge): blue-painted 'BOUTIQUE' over the door and, on the side wall, the hand-painted name 'Kaze Muronke' with a Kirundi list of goods (rice, beans, oil, soap, salt, airtime units). A yellow Lumitel/Lumicash sticker and a tiny painter's credit are distractors. Two women seated at the shop are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Butike kaze muronke yo mu Nkayamba.jpg

author: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard
attribution: Photo: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Supr%C3%AAme_bar_restaurant_i.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Lettering painted along a white perimeter wall across the street, tilted; 'SUPREME' in black, 'BAR' in red, 'RESTAURANT' in yellow (no accent painted). Tiny text above ('MUSIC & PIANO BAR', 'RESTAURANT', 'PARTY H...') is too small to transcribe; the 'SUPREME BAR' logo board above is a repeat.

author: greyfalcon33
attribution: Photo: greyfalcon33, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hospital_Entrance_Sign_for_Kibuye_Hope_Hospital_in_Burundi.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White hospital name board on a brick wall with the Free Methodist logo. The red Kirundi motto is in guillemets; spacing around the final full stop and » is approximate. Accents are omitted on the sign ('HOPITAL', 'EGLISE', 'METHODISTE').
source_title: File:Hospital Entrance Sign for Kibuye Hope Hospital in Burundi.jpg

author: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard
attribution: Photo: NIHEREWENIMANA Richard, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Restaurant_Eden.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted sandwich board with a green arrow pointing left, Gitega; tilted, and the photographer's fingertip covers the lower part of 'Ed'. Another 'RESTAURANT Eden' board at upper left and a truck plate at right are distractors.

author: Ntahonsigaye
attribution: Photo: Ntahonsigaye, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bienvenue_%C3%A0_la_R%C3%A9serve_Naturelle_de_Rumonge.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: SAUVEGARDONS CETTE FORET POUR UN AVENIR MEILLEUR

notes: Welcome board with the Burundi coat of arms and OBPE logo; the brackets around NYAMIRAMBO are red. Alternative query: 'Nyamirambo'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Bienvenue à la Réserve Naturelle de Rumonge.jpg

author: Ntahonsigaye
attribution: Photo: Ntahonsigaye, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%C3%80_la_d%C3%A9couverte_de_la_beaut%C3%A9_de_la_R%C3%A9serve_Naturelle_Karonda.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside welcome board on the RN3 near Rumonge, with painted baboon and bird; coat of arms and OBPE logo in the top corners. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:À la découverte de la beauté de la Réserve Naturelle Karonda.jpg

author: Alain Fortuné14
attribution: Photo: Alain Fortuné14, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Burundi_is_Really_Beautiful_(7).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small blue street-name plate with white border on a compound wall at right, Bujumbura; very small in frame and oversaturated. A third line with a numeric code (looks like '10 01 03') is not reliably legible and is left out. The tiny house-number plate by the gate is a distractor.

author: Alain Fortuné14
attribution: Photo: Alain Fortuné14, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AmAzing_BURUNDI_(34).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Shop fascia in Bujumbura photographed tilted about 35 degrees with heavily boosted colours; food photos crowd the board. The small script lines under the name (bakery/grocery words) are left out. A second board on the left shows the same name with 'Avenue de Grèce N° 19', and a blue street plate 'AVENUE DE GRECE' with a code number stands in front; both are distractors.

author: Kibengado
attribution: Photo: Kibengado, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:La_rivi%C3%A8reRuvubu_03.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black river-name sign with three white wave lines, beside the Ruvubu river (Karusi province).

author: Gashi.bdi
attribution: Photo: Gashi.bdi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:A_sign_in_the_entry_of_bururi_natural_reserve.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Title of a large information board (French in black, Kirundi in blue) with coat of arms and World Bank logo. The Kirundi rules list, the slogan band and the PRRPB project text below are distractors; the board's lower edge is torn.
source_title: File:A sign in the entry of bururi natural reserve.jpg

author: Zamennest
attribution: Photo: Zamennest, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indication_des_chutes_de_karera_%C3%A0_rutana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow lettering painted on a green concrete block at the Karera falls site, Rutana: 'Welcome to the very beautiful falls of Karera' in Kirundi.
source_title: File:Indication des chutes de karera à rutana.jpg

author: Zamennest
attribution: Photo: Zamennest, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indication_et_bureau_des_failles_des_allemands_%C3%A0_kiguhu,Rutana.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: MINISTERE DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT, DE L’AGRICULTURE ET DE
OFFICE BURUNDAIS POUR LA PROTECTION DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT
KAZE MU BIMANGA VY’ INYAKAZU / VY’ABADAGI
BIENVENUE AUX FAILLES DE NYAKAZU / DES ALLEMANDS

notes: Green trilingual (French/Kirundi/English) welcome board at the Nyakazu faults (Failles des Allemands), Rutana; seen at an angle. 'MINISTERE' and 'DE' are run together on the board. Apostrophes are typographic (’). The French descriptive paragraph below the paintings and the partner logos (BIOPAMA, EU flag) are distractors.
source_title: File:Indication et bureau des failles des allemands à kiguhu,Rutana.jpg
